serverInfo.name: MoneyMatter Finance Tracker
serverInfo.title: MoneyMatter — Personal Finance MCP Server
serverInfo.description: OAuth-secured read/write access to your MoneyMatter financial data: accounts, transactions (including splits, refunds, transfers, and groups), trackers, savings goals, subscriptions, transaction automations (rules engine), categories, tags, cash flow, balance history, spending analytics, and investment portfolios (holdings, cash balances, and investment transactions). Supports creating, editing, and deleting records when the corresponding scopes are granted. Enables natural-language queries and automation of your personal finances.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile (name, email, default currency).

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: List the user's financial accounts with balances, types, and currencies.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read one account: balances, opening balance, credit limit, bank link, logo and its transaction count.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a manual account with a currency, category, opening balance, credit limit and logo.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update an account's name, category, credit limit, stats exclusion, logo or balance.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search and filter transactions across accounts by date, category, tag, payee, planned state, amount, or merchant; each result carries its payee.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Read transactions by id (up to 50) or both legs of a transfer by transferId, with payee, optionally with splits and tags.

tools.name: get_transactions_summary
tools.description: Count and base-currency totals (income, expense, net, transfers) of the transactions matching the list filters.

tools.name: get_planned_summary
tools.description: Totals of planned (upcoming, unconfirmed) transactions per account and currency.

tools.name: confirm_planned_transaction
tools.description: Confirm a planned transaction once the money has moved; settles a linked subscription period. Bank-account plans are confirmed by sync. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: bulk_delete_transactions
tools.description: Permanently delete many transactions by ids or by filters (at least one filter is required). Irreversible. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_transaction_links
tools.description: Read a transaction's portfolio transfer link and venture event link (each null when absent).

tools.name: list_transaction_attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a transaction: id, filename, type and size.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete a file attached to a transaction. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List spending and income categories, including custom user-defined categories.

tools.name: get_category_transaction_count
tools.description: Count the transactions filed under a category (planned and split lines included); check it before delete_category.

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: List transaction tags used to annotate spending. Pass tagId to read one tag with its description.

tools.name: get_trackers
tools.description: Retrieve active and historical trackers with their limits, category and tag rules, and lines.

tools.name: get_tracker
tools.description: Read one tracker with its date range, limit, categories and stats: income, expense, balance and how much of the limit is used.

tools.name: create_tracker
tools.description: Create a new tracker with an optional spending limit, date range, category and tag rules, and smart tracking.

tools.name: update_tracker
tools.description: Update an existing tracker's name, date range, spending limit, category and tag rules, or smart tracking settings.

tools.name: delete_tracker
tools.description: Permanently delete a tracker and all its transaction links.

tools.name: archive_tracker
tools.description: Archive or restore a tracker (sets status to archived or active).

tools.name: add_transactions_to_tracker
tools.description: Manually link transactions to a tracker.

tools.name: remove_transactions_from_tracker
tools.description: Unlink transactions from a tracker without deleting them.

tools.name: get_tracker_spending_stats
tools.description: Spending breakdown by category, time-series of expense vs income, and per-line spent for a tracker.

tools.name: create_tracker_line
tools.description: Add a line (named category set with an optional limit) to a tracker.

tools.name: update_tracker_line
tools.description: Update a tracker line's name, categories, limit, or position.

tools.name: delete_tracker_line
tools.description: Permanently delete a line from a tracker.

tools.name: list_tracker_suggestions
tools.description: Smart-tracking suggestions, AI-matched transactions, and scan status for a tracker the user owns.

tools.name: accept_tracker_suggestions
tools.description: Accept pending smart-tracking suggestions, linking their transactions to the tracker.

tools.name: reject_tracker_suggestions
tools.description: Reject smart-tracking suggestions; AI-linked or accepted ones are also unlinked from the tracker.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: List savings goals with target, backing accounts and their shares, and progress (current value, pace, ETA, needed per month) in the goal currency.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a savings goal funded by percentage shares of one or more accounts.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a savings goal's target, date, monthly plan, accounts, or status (active, paused, archived).

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.description: Permanently delete a savings goal and free its account shares.

tools.name: get_tracker_transactions
tools.description: List the transactions a category tracker counts, newest first, with one entry per matching split; manual trackers use search_transactions with trackerIds.

tools.name: get_spending_by_categories
tools.description: Aggregate spending by category over a specified date range.

tools.name: get_cash_flow
tools.description: Summarize income vs expenses over a specified date range.

tools.name: get_balance_history
tools.description: Time-series of account balances for a given range and granularity.

tools.name: get_expenses_for_period
tools.description: Summarize expenses for a given time period with breakdowns.

tools.name: get_total_balance
tools.description: Total balance across all accounts on one date, in the base currency, net of credit limits when the user setting is on.

tools.name: get_net_worth_history
tools.description: Net worth over time with assets and liabilities by kind, weekly to yearly points, in the base currency.

tools.name: get_net_worth_drivers
tools.description: What moved net worth per period: savings, investment growth, dividends, fees and the holdings and cash values, optionally for some portfolios.

tools.name: get_investment_contributions
tools.description: Money moved into portfolios per period with the split per portfolio and the period's net savings.

tools.name: get_venture_contributions
tools.description: Net amount contributed to each venture deal over a date range.

tools.name: get_pivot_report
tools.description: Cross-tab of spending or income: categories, subcategories, payees or tags against time columns, with totals.

tools.name: get_cumulative_stats
tools.description: Running monthly totals of expenses, income or savings for a period next to the period before it, with the percent change.

tools.name: get_earliest_transaction_date
tools.description: Date of the first transaction on record, or null when there are none.

tools.name: get_portfolios
tools.description: List the user's investment portfolios with type, enabled state, and metadata.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Read one portfolio by id: name, type, description, enabled state and creation date.

tools.name: get_portfolios_overview
tools.description: Summaries and annualized returns of all portfolios in one call.

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Portfolio-level aggregates: total value, cost basis, realized and unrealized gains, and cash balances in the user's base currency.

tools.name: get_portfolio_holdings
tools.description: Positions held in a portfolio with market value, cost basis, and realized/unrealized gains. Includes embedded security details.

tools.name: get_portfolio_balances
tools.description: Cash balances held in a portfolio, broken down per currency (original and base-currency equivalents).

tools.name: get_investment_transactions
tools.description: Investment transaction history (buy, sell, dividend, transfer, tax, fee) with security and portfolio details.

tools.name: search_securities
tools.description: Search for securities by ticker or company name. Each result can be passed unchanged to create_holding, which returns the securityId that create_investment_transaction needs.

tools.name: get_security_prices
tools.description: Stored closing prices of one security, optionally within a date range, oldest first.

tools.name: create_holding
tools.description: Add a security to a portfolio, from a known securityId or a search_securities result (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: delete_holding
tools.description: Remove a security from a portfolio; force=true also deletes its investment transactions and reverses their cash effect (requires finance:delete scope).

tools.name: create_portfolio
tools.description: Create a new investment portfolio (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: update_portfolio
tools.description: Update portfolio name, type, description, or enabled state (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: delete_portfolio
tools.description: Permanently delete a portfolio and optionally all its data (requires finance:delete scope).

tools.name: restore_portfolio
tools.description: Restore a portfolio that was deleted without force, with its holdings and balances (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: create_investment_transaction
tools.description: Record a new investment transaction (buy, sell, dividend, fee, etc.) in a portfolio (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: update_investment_transaction
tools.description: Update an existing investment transaction's category, date, quantity, price, or fees (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: delete_investment_transaction
tools.description: Permanently delete an investment transaction and recalculate affected holding (requires finance:delete scope).

tools.name: link_transaction_to_portfolio
tools.description: Link an existing transaction to a portfolio as a cash transfer (expense = cash in, income = cash out) (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: unlink_transaction_from_portfolio
tools.description: Remove a transaction's portfolio link, reversing the portfolio cash balance change (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: transfer_account_to_portfolio
tools.description: Move cash from a regular account into a portfolio, creating the expense transaction (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: transfer_portfolio_to_account
tools.description: Withdraw portfolio cash into a regular account, creating the income transaction (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: create_portfolio_cash_transaction
tools.description: Record a direct portfolio cash deposit or withdrawal with no linked account transaction (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: transfer_between_portfolios
tools.description: Move cash from one portfolio to another in one currency, creating no account transaction (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: exchange_portfolio_currency
tools.description: Record a currency exchange inside a portfolio: sell one cash currency, buy another (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: list_portfolio_transfers
tools.description: Cash movement history of a portfolio: transfers, deposits/withdrawals, linked transactions, and currency exchanges.

tools.name: set_portfolio_transfer_adjustment
tools.description: Flag a portfolio transfer as an adjustment, which drops it from the contributions report, or clear the flag (requires finance:write scope).

tools.name: delete_portfolio_transfer
tools.description: Permanently delete a portfolio transfer and reverse its cash effect, optionally with the linked account transaction (requires finance:delete scope).

tools.name: adjust_account_balance
tools.description: Set an account to a specific balance by creating an adjustment transaction for the difference.

tools.name: archive_account
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a user account, with full side-effect handling (group removal, subscription unlinking).

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Permanently delete an account together with all its transactions.

tools.name: unlink_account_from_bank_connection
tools.description: Disconnect a bank-connected account from its bank; it becomes a manual account and keeps its history.

tools.name: get_account_groups
tools.description: List the account groups (nested folders) with their parent, path, child groups and accounts, or the account ids of one group.

tools.name: create_account_group
tools.description: Create an account group, optionally nested under a parent group. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_account_group
tools.description: Rename an account group, change its parent or its logo. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: move_account_group
tools.description: Move an account group under another group or to the top level. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_account_group
tools.description: Delete an account group; its accounts are kept and only ungrouped. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: add_account_to_group
tools.description: Put an account into an account group (an account sits in one group at a time). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: remove_accounts_from_group
tools.description: Take accounts out of an account group. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_transaction_groups
tools.description: List all transaction groups with aggregate counts and date ranges, or with full embedded transactions. Pass groupId to read one group with its transactions.

tools.name: create_transaction_group
tools.description: Create a new transaction group bundling related transactions (e.g. a split bill). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction_group
tools.description: Update the name or note of an existing transaction group. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction_group
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction group (transactions themselves are kept). Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: add_transactions_to_group
tools.description: Add transactions to an existing transaction group. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: remove_transactions_from_group
tools.description: Remove transactions from a group, optionally dissolving it if too few remain. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_subscriptions
tools.description: List all subscriptions and recurring bills with frequency, expected amount, and linked transaction count.

tools.name: get_subscription_by_id
tools.description: Retrieve a single subscription with all linked transactions and the computed next expected payment date.

tools.name: create_subscription
tools.description: Create a new subscription, recurring bill, or installment plan — an expense by default, or a recurring income (e.g. salary) via transactionType. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Update fields on an existing subscription or bill. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_subscription
tools.description: Permanently delete a subscription and its transaction links. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: toggle_subscription_active
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a subscription to include or exclude it from upcoming payment calculations. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: detect_subscription_candidates
tools.description: Scan past 12 months of transactions to detect recurring payment patterns. Cached for 1 hour. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: list_subscription_candidates
tools.description: List auto-detected subscription candidates sorted by confidence score.

tools.name: dismiss_subscription_candidate
tools.description: Dismiss a pending subscription candidate so it no longer appears in the list. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: link_transactions_to_subscription
tools.description: Link transactions to a subscription to mark them as payment instances. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_transactions_from_subscription
tools.description: Unlink transactions from a subscription without deleting them. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_upcoming_subscription_payments
tools.description: List upcoming subscription payments sorted by next expected payment date.

tools.name: get_subscriptions_summary
tools.description: Aggregate summary across all active subscriptions, split by direction: estimated monthly and projected yearly cost from expense subscriptions, expected monthly income from income subscriptions, and active counts as { expense, income }, all in the user's base currency.

tools.name: accept_subscription_candidate
tools.description: Accept a pending subscription candidate, optionally attaching its sample transactions to an existing subscription. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: list_subscription_match_suggestions
tools.description: List past transactions that a subscription's matching rules would match but that are not linked to it yet.

tools.name: get_subscription_periods
tools.description: List a subscription's billing periods, newest first, with the status of each and the transaction behind a paid one.

tools.name: preview_subscription_payment
tools.description: Preview what paying a subscription period would book, and the payments already recorded for it. Changes nothing.

tools.name: pay_subscription_period
tools.description: Mark a subscription period as paid, linking an existing transaction or booking a new one. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: skip_subscription_period
tools.description: Skip a subscription period without paying it and open the next one. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_subscription_period_transaction
tools.description: Detach the transaction a subscription period points at, keeping the transaction and the paid status. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: revert_subscription_period
tools.description: Undo a paid or skipped subscription period. Deletes the transaction the app created for the payment, which also needs finance:delete scope. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Create a new income, expense, or transfer transaction with optional splits, tags, category, payee, and original (foreign-currency) amount.

tools.name: create_attachment_upload_url
tools.description: Returns a short-lived URL and headers for uploading receipt/invoice files (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF) to a transaction over HTTP. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Update an existing transaction's amount, date, category, payee, tags, note, splits, or original (foreign-currency) amount. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction. For transfers, both sides are deleted. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: bulk_update_transactions
tools.description: Update multiple transactions at once — set category, payee, note, or add/replace/remove tags. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: split_transaction
tools.description: Split a transaction across multiple categories; amounts must sum to the transaction total. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_split
tools.description: Delete a single split from a transaction by its split ID. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: link_transfer
tools.description: Link two existing transactions as a transfer pair (opposite types, different accounts). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_transfer
tools.description: Unlink a transfer pair by transferId; both transactions become independent entries. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: link_refund
tools.description: Mark an existing transaction as a refund of another transaction. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_refund
tools.description: Remove a refund link between two transactions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_refunds
tools.description: Read refund links: the refunds of one transaction, one refund pair, or a paged list filtered by category, account and type. Each link carries both transactions with their payee.

tools.name: get_refund_recommendations
tools.description: Suggest up to 5 transactions a refund could be linked to (opposite type, last 6 months, within 50 in the base currency), for a saved transaction or for form data.

tools.name: get_transfer_recommendations
tools.description: Suggest up to 7 transactions that could be the other leg of a transfer (opposite type, other account, within 10% and 14 days), for a saved transaction or for form data.

tools.name: list_transfer_suggestions
tools.description: Scan a period for expenses that look like one leg of a transfer, each with up to 4 scored candidate incomes. Reads only; refused while a base-currency change runs.

tools.name: dismiss_transfer_suggestion
tools.description: Dismiss a suggested expense/income pair as not a transfer, so scans stop offering it. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_reconciliation_history
tools.description: List past duplicate removals and merges, newest first, with the removed rows and the survivor of each merge.

tools.name: list_stuck_pending_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions pending for over 7 days with the booked row that likely replaced each.

tools.name: remove_duplicate_transactions
tools.description: Remove duplicate transactions from the books; restorable, but their budget, group and subscription links are not. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: restore_removed_transactions
tools.description: Bring back transactions removed or merged by reconciliation, without the links they lost. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: merge_duplicate_transactions
tools.description: Merge 2 to 4 duplicates of one account into a survivor that takes their links; restorable. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: keep_pending_as_booked
tools.description: Confirm stuck pending bank transactions as booked so they stop showing as stuck. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: assign_tags_to_transaction
tools.description: Assign one or more tags to a transaction; already-assigned tags are silently skipped. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: remove_tags_from_transaction
tools.description: Remove tags from one or more transactions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Create a new transaction category, optionally nested under a parent. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_category
tools.description: Rename, recolor, or change the icon of a category. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_category
tools.description: Permanently delete a category; supply replaceWithCategoryId to reassign linked transactions (see get_category_transaction_count). Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag that can be assigned to transactions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.description: Rename, recolor, or update the description of a tag. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag and unlink it from all transactions. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_tag_reminders
tools.description: List tag reminders (notify when a tag total passes an amount, or when a tag has no transaction in a period); optionally for one tag or one reminder.

tools.name: create_tag_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder on a tag: an amount threshold in the base currency or an existence check, scheduled or real-time. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_tag_reminder
tools.description: Update a tag reminder; null clears the schedule, isEnabled pauses it. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_tag_reminder
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag reminder. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: List in-app notifications (budget alerts, reminders, bank sync messages), newest first, with the total and the unread count; filter by status or type, or read one by id.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark one notification read, or all unread ones when no id is given. Works for read-only accounts. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: dismiss_notification
tools.description: Dismiss a notification so it leaves the default list and the unread count. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_user_settings
tools.description: Read the user's app settings (language, notification preferences, dashboard, layout, saved views, import and bank sync options, FIRE planner inputs). The AI configuration is not included.

tools.name: update_user_settings
tools.description: Change app settings with a partial patch merged into the stored ones; arrays replace the stored array whole; a fire key needs the FIRE planner plan. The AI configuration cannot be changed. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_payees
tools.description: List Payees (merchants/counterparties) for the user, optionally filtered by a substring query. Returns Payee id, name, defaultCategoryId, and aggregated stats (transactionCount, netFlowRef, top category, last seen).

tools.name: get_payee
tools.description: Fetch a single Payee with aliases and computed stats. Useful when the user references a merchant by id and wants its full record.

tools.name: create_payee
tools.description: Create a Payee (merchant/counterparty) for the user. Use when the user wants to register a new merchant before linking transactions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_payee
tools.description: Update a Payee: rename it (the old name is kept as an alias), set its default category and categorization mode, default tags, default location and logo. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: merge_payees
tools.description: Merge a source Payee into a target Payee. Transactions and aliases move to the target; the target wins silently on defaultCategoryId conflict; the source is deleted. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_payee
tools.description: Delete a Payee. Linked transactions retain their categoryId but their payeeId is set to null. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: set_payees_categorization_mode
tools.description: Set the categorization mode of every payee the user has to the same value. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: bulk_delete_payees
tools.description: Permanently delete many payees at once, all or nothing, optionally adding their names to the ignored list. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_ignored_payee_names
tools.description: List the names that are never turned into payees automatically.

tools.name: ignore_payee_name
tools.description: Add a name to the ignored list. With force it also permanently deletes the payee the name resolves to, which needs finance:delete scope. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unignore_payee_name
tools.description: Remove a name from the ignored list. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: apply_payee_tags_to_transactions
tools.description: Add a payee's default tags to every transaction already linked to it; it only adds tags. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_payee_alias
tools.description: Add an alias to a payee, another name that links future transactions to it. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_payee_alias
tools.description: Delete one alias of a payee. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_transaction_automations
tools.description: List the user's transaction automation rules with their evaluation order (position), enabled state, match counts, and pausedReason when a referenced record was deleted.

tools.name: preview_transaction_automation
tools.description: Dry-run a set of automation conditions against up to the last 1000 eligible existing transactions and return matchedCount, scannedCount, and up to 5 sample matches. Nothing is modified.

tools.name: create_transaction_automation
tools.description: Create a transaction automation rule that sets a category, tags, payee, or note on newly synced or imported bank transactions that match its conditions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction_automation
tools.description: Update the name, enabled state, conditions, or actions of an automation rule. Re-validates referenced records and clears pausedReason. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction_automation
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction automation rule. Transactions it already changed keep their values. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: reorder_transaction_automations
tools.description: Set the top-to-bottom evaluation order of the automation rules. Requires the full current id set. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: apply_transaction_automation
tools.description: Run one saved automation rule on up to 500 existing transactions; ids that no longer match are skipped. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_transaction_templates
tools.description: List transaction templates: named presets for filling new transactions.

tools.name: create_transaction_template
tools.description: Create a transaction template (named preset: type, account, pinned amount, category, payee, tags). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction_template
tools.description: Update a transaction template; null clears a field and tagIds replaces the tag set. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction template. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: list_venture_platforms
tools.description: List the user's venture investment platforms with their default fee fractions (entry fee, mgmt fee, carry, hurdle).

tools.name: get_venture_platform
tools.description: Retrieve a single venture platform by id, including its default fee fractions.

tools.name: create_venture_platform
tools.description: Create a venture investment platform (syndicator, fund manager) with default fees that auto-apply to new deals. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_venture_platform
tools.description: Update a venture platform's name, website, description, or default fees. Does not change fees on existing deals. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_platform
tools.description: Delete a venture platform; deals referencing it have their platformId cleared. Supports soft-delete or hard-delete via force. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: list_venture_deals
tools.description: List the user's venture deals (illiquid private investments) with status, platform, currency, principal, fees, and dates.

tools.name: get_venture_deal
tools.description: Retrieve a single venture deal by id with platform and currency; optionally embed its event history.

tools.name: get_venture_deal_metrics
tools.description: Compute aggregated metrics for a venture deal: cost basis, current value, distributions, P&L, TVPI, DPI, and IRR (as of an optional date).

tools.name: create_venture_deal
tools.description: Create a venture deal. Snapshots platform fees by default. Optionally creates the initial_investment event in the same operation. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_venture_deal
tools.description: Update a venture deal. Terms (principal, fees, dates, currency) are locked once events exist. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_deal
tools.description: Delete a venture deal; cascade-deletes its events. Linked bank transactions are unlinked and restored. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: list_venture_events
tools.description: List events for a venture deal in chronological order, with their amounts, cash-flow modes, and linked bank transactions.

tools.name: get_venture_event
tools.description: Retrieve a single venture event by id, including its linked bank transactions.

tools.name: create_venture_event
tools.description: Record an event on a venture deal (initial_investment must come first). Auto-computes carry on distributions and exits. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_venture_event
tools.description: Update a venture event. Manual gpCarry/lpNet values set override flags; resetOverrides=true re-runs auto-compute. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_event
tools.description: Delete a venture event; unlinks bank transactions first. Cannot delete initial_investment while other events exist. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: link_transactions_to_venture_event
tools.description: Link bank transactions to a venture event as its cash; same currency, not linked elsewhere, summing to the event's lpNetAmount. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: replace_venture_event_links
tools.description: Replace all bank transactions linked to a venture event with a new set, or none. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_event_link
tools.description: Remove one transaction link from a venture event; the transaction gets its original state back. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: list_custom_currencies
tools.description: List the user's custom currencies (points, tokens, local units) with code, name, symbol, decimals, and logo.

tools.name: create_custom_currency
tools.description: Define a custom currency for the user. The code must not be an ISO code; base-currency values need a rate source or manual rates. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_custom_currency
tools.description: Change a custom currency's name, decimals, symbol, or logo. Decimals cannot change while the currency is in use. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_custom_currency
tools.description: Delete a custom currency and the user's exchange rates for it. Refused while any account, transaction, or other record uses it. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: search_coingecko_coins
tools.description: Search CoinGecko coins by name or symbol to find the coinId for a CoinGecko rate source. Needs the instance's CoinGecko key.

tools.name: get_currency_rate_history
tools.description: List a custom currency's stored rates, latest first, with source, effective date, and which rate is in force. Paged, up to 100 per page.

tools.name: set_currency_rate_source
tools.description: Set how a currency gets its rates: provider, manual, peg, coingecko, or http. A change re-values saved rows of a custom currency. Rate limited to 20 per minute. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: test_currency_rate_source
tools.description: Preview an HTTP rate source: fetches one day's rate with the given URL template and JSON path and saves nothing. Rate limited to 20 per minute. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: set_exchange_rates
tools.description: Set exchange rates for currency pairs, each pair with its opposite in the same call. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_exchange_rates
tools.description: Remove the user's own exchange rates for pairs, each with its opposite, so they fall back to market rates. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_user_currencies
tools.description: Get the user's held currencies, base currency and today's rates to the base in one result.

tools.name: list_supported_currencies
tools.description: List every ISO currency the app supports, with code, name and decimals.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Read the rate of one currency pair for a day as the app values it, or the global market rates stored for that day.

tools.name: add_user_currencies
tools.description: Add ISO or custom currencies to the ones the user holds, with an optional flat rate and live-rate flag. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_user_currency
tools.description: Change a held currency's flat rate or switch it between the market rate and a manual one; re-values stored balances. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_user_currency
tools.description: Stop holding an ISO currency. Refused for the base currency and for currencies in use. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: change_base_currency
tools.description: Set the base currency: at once for a user with none, otherwise as a background change that recalculates all history and blocks other edits until it finishes. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_base_currency_change_status
tools.description: Get the state of the running or last base-currency change: idle, queued, running, completed or failed.

tools.name: get_loans
tools.description: List the loans with balance, terms and payoff projection, or read one with its timeline.

tools.name: get_loan_balance_history
tools.description: Outstanding balance of a loan over time, one point per payment day, newest points when limited.

tools.name: create_loan
tools.description: Create a loan with its terms; returns it with a payoff projection. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_loan
tools.description: Update a loan's balance, rate, term, payments or lender details. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_loan
tools.description: Permanently delete a loan with no recorded payments. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: add_loan_note
tools.description: Add a note to the timeline of a loan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: link_loan_payments
tools.description: Record existing expense transactions as payments on a loan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_loan_payment
tools.description: Undo a loan payment; the source transaction is restored. Requires finance:write scope.

prompts.name: financial_data_guide
prompts.description: Guide for working with MoneyMatter's financial data, including data model and common query patterns.
